Derzeit nutzt das Land Nordrhein-Westfalen das E-Akte-System nscale mit dem Modul nscale eGov der Firma Ceyoniq Technology GmbH. Die Ausschreibung umfasst die Bereitstellung und Weiterentwicklung der notwendigen Software, die Implementierung und Integration in die bestehende IT-Infrastruktur sowie Supportleistungen (Third-Level-Support). Die Ausschreibung umfasst außerdem produktbezogene Leistungen zur Wissensvermittlung, Schulung und Einführungsunterstützung der E-Akte.

title: Denmark – Advertising and marketing services – Udbud af medieydelser
description: Forsvarsministeriets Materiel- og Indkøbsstyrelse (FMI) udbyder en 2-årige rammeaftale vedrørende medieydelser. Aftalen indeholder mulighed for forlængelse i op til 2 år. Aftalen vil blive indgået af FMI, men alle enheder under Forsvarsministeriet, herunder alle divisioner af Forsvaret i Danmark, som er under Forsvarschefens kommando, samt Beredskabsstyrelsen er imidlertid berettigede til at benytte aftalen til indkøb på aftalens vilkår og betingelser. De primære brugere forventes at være Personelkommandoen samt Hjemmeværnskommandoen. Denne rammeaftale om medieydelser indeholder visse grænseflader med FMI’s rammeaftale om reklameydelser, hvorfor samarbejdet mellem leverandørerne på de to aftaler er af stor betydning for, at købers markedsføringsindsatser opnår maksimal effekt. Såfremt der opstår et overlap i de ydelser, som skal leveres i henhold til de to rammeaftaler, vil FMI indkøbe ydelserne i henhold til rammeaftalen om reklameydelser. Køberen har imidlertid ret til at købe tilsvarende tjenesteydelser fra andre leverandører. - Aftalen angår medieydelser, der skal understøtte attraktionsopgaven i forbindelse med rekrutteringen til Køber samt Købers øvrige behov for medierådgivning eller medieformidling. Aftalen vil således blive benyttet til strategisk medieplanlægning, udvikling og eksekvering af medieplaner samt indkøb af medieplads til rimelige priser inden for de fleste mediegrupper – såvel online som offline. Herunder har Køber behov for rådgivning indenfor SEM og SEO. Aftalen omfatter også evaluering og effektmåling af eksponeringer. Køber er en politisk styret organisation, som beskæftiger sig med politiske potentielt følsomme emner. Det stiller krav til leverandører og samarbejdspartnere i forhold til at evne at manøvrere i krydsfeltet mellem politisk styring og optimal løsning af attraktionsopgaven. - Aftalen angår medieydelser og inkluderer bl.a.: Ydelser af strategisk karakter, herunder rådgivning om og udvikling af den overordnede, samlende mediestrategi for mediekøb, herunder i forhold til mål og målgrupper, platforms- og kanalvalg og evaluering, samt afklaring af mål og delmål på kort og længere sigt under inddragelse af målgruppeundersøgelser, analyser mv. Ydelser af taktisk karakter, herunder medieformidling, research af medier, inddragelse af målgrupper og marked samt medieplanlægning. Ydelser af operationel karakter, herunder forhandlinger med medieudbydere om priser, rabatter, placeringer mv., samt booking af og indrykning af materialer på medieplatforme. Ydelser af operationel karakter omfatter endvidere gennemførelse af understøttende overvågning af priser, rabatter mv. i markedet. Selve medieindkøbet samt distribution af mediemateriale er at betragte som ydelser på det operationelle niveau. Leverandøren skal på tværs af de tre niveauer foretage projektstyring, herunder løbende kontakt til og samarbejde med Køber i forbindelse med udvikling og eksekvering af mediestrategi. Rammeaftalen indeholder en honorarmodel bestående af 3 elementer: Kampagnebaseret procentvederlag, timebaseret honorar og eksterne specialydelser. Honorarmodellen omfatter prisgarantier på mediepriserne. Der sker opfølgning herpå, hvorved de faktiske medieindkøbspriser sammenholdes med de garanterede mediepriser. Ved afvigelser fra de garanterede mediepriser pålægges leverandøren en bod. Se nærmere om honorarmodellen i Bilag 8, samt Bilag 2.1.1 og Bilag 2.1.2. - Se kravspecifikation (Bilag 1) til rammeaftalen for yderligere oplysninger.

buyer: Avon and Wiltshire Mental Health Partnership NHS trust
title: CA18282 - Provision of 111-2 Service
description: This opportunity is being run under the Provider Selection Regime (PSR) regulations. The development of a specialist all age mental health response via 111 is a key ambition of the NHS England Long Term Plan (2021-2024), and the recovery plan for urgent and emergency care priority for 2023/24. This required all calls for support during mental health crisis to be made via 111 by the end of March 2024 and is referred to as 111-2. Avon and Wiltshire Mental Health Partnership NHS Trust (AWP) currently deliver this service in partnership with a system partner. AWP is seeking a provider to deliver an integrated model for the NHS 111 Mental Health Crisis Response Service (111 Option 2) for individuals experiencing a mental health crisis across both adult (18 years and over) and children and young people (under 18 years) pathways. The appointed provider will be solely responsible for the delivery of the call handling element of the 111 Option 2 pathway, including access, triage and call management. AWP will retain responsibility for all clinical assessment activity and associated clinical decision-making and outcomes. The provider must be able to operate within a matrix management model, whereby all partners maintain responsibility for their own governance arrangements, professional standards and areas of specialist expertise, while working collaboratively at both strategic and operational leadership levels to deliver a seamless, integrated and high-quality service. The service forms part of the NHS England requirement that callers contacting NHS 111 and selecting the mental health option are connected directly to a dedicated mental health response service available 24 hours per day, 7 days per week. The service will work collaboratively with urgent and emergency care pathways, crisis services, community mental health teams, acute hospitals, ambulance services, primary care and voluntary sector partners. To access this competition: Registered: Login to https://suppliers.multiquote.com and view the opportunity CA18282. Not registered: Visit https://suppliers.multiquote.com then register and quote CA18282 as the reason for registration. Not registered: Visit https://suppliers.multiquote.com then register and quote CA18282 as the reason for registration. Any queries please contact MultiQuote on 020 3920 8054.

title: TD2340 - Framework for Highways Services
description: The Council is seeking to establish a multi-supplier Highways Framework Agreement to support the delivery of highway maintenance, improvement, construction, specialist services, materials supply, plant hire and associated activities across the highway network and related infrastructure. The Framework will provide a compliant and flexible route to market for planned and reactive works and services and will be divided into the following 11 lots: Lot 1 - Road Markings & High Friction Surfacing Lot 2 - Road Restraint Systems Lot 3 - Temporary Traffic Management Lot 4 - Traffic Signals Lot 5 - Multi-Disciplined Lot 6 - Carriageway Maintenance Lot 7 - Carriageway and Footway Surface Treatments Lot 8 - Hire of Equipment (with/without Operators) Lot 9 - Haulage with Driver Lot 10 - Supply of Asphalt Lot 11 - Highways Resource Support The Framework has an estimated core value of £72 million over its full term. In anticipation of Local Government Reorganisation (LGR), the Council reserves the right to vary the scope, value and volume of services procured through the Framework. Should additional requirements arise as a result of LGR, the total estimated Framework value may increase to a maximum of £108 million. The values attributed to individual lots are indicative only and do not represent any guarantee of expenditure. Actual spend may vary between lots depending on operational requirements, available funding and any changes arising from LGR. Call-off contracts may include highway maintenance works, specialist highway services, traffic management, supply of materials, plant and equipment hire, haulage services and resource support. Requirements may range from small-scale reactive works to larger planned maintenance and capital improvement schemes. Appointment to the Framework does not guarantee any minimum value or volume of work. Call-off contracts may be awarded by direct award and/or further competition in accordance with the Framework terms and procurement documents.

title: Four Year Framework Agreement for Main Building Contractors for New Build Housing with a possible one year extension
description: Link Group intends to enter into a Framework Agreement with a limited number of Building Contractors to provide construction services for a four year period with a possible one year extension. This may also include the provision of design and construction services. Link works in partnership with a number of subsidiary companies who will also be entitled to purchase works & services from the Framework Agreement. The subsidiaries of Link Group Ltd currently include, Link Living, C~urb 6 Ltd (C~urb), Horizon Housing Association Ltd, Larkfield Housing Association and West Highland Housing Association. Although it is possible that other organisations may join the Group, becoming subsidiary companies, during the term of the Framework Agreement, and may also wish to "call off" from the Framework. Link also works in partnership with several external organisations, refer to Section 1.1 of the Contract Notice for further detail, who will also be entitled to purchase services from the Framework Agreement. In addition, it is also intended that any Registered Social Landlord registered and operating in Scotland will be entitled to purchase works & services from the framework, subject to Link's prior agreement. There is no guarantee of any work. It is however, more than likely that individual commissions will be "called off" either by direct selection or by mini tendering, within the terms of the Framework Agreement, to identify the most economically advantageous tender. The Framework Agreement will mainly cover the provision of construction works & services for new build housing, however individual projects may also include rehabilitation of existing properties, office and commercial properties, extensions, community facilities and adaptations, and planned maintenance projects. The projects will range in size, tenure and type from mainstream housing to a variety of special needs projects. The tenure type will cover all affordable tenures, private rented and market sale. Applicants should have experience of projects within the social housing sector for projects between 5 and 500 units including flats, houses and retirement living projects with a mix of tenures. The location of projects will vary but in the main will be located in the Central Belt of Scotland, Argyll & Bute and Highland, however individual projects may be located in any part of Scotland. The total number of units in each of the geographical areas may vary and specific numbers cannot be guaranteed in any area or in total. Although individual projects cannot be guaranteed, Link will expect the successful contractors to deliver a high quality and value for money service.

title: Brodick Country Park Conservation Works
description: This tender comprises of two lots: Lot 1 â Stock Fence Replacement Replacement of defective sections of stock fencing within two fields in the Castle Parks are required to maintain secure livestock enclosures and support the continued use of conservation grazing as part of the management of the parkland grasslands. Grazing helps maintain the open character of the fields, manage vegetation structure, limit scrub encroachment and contribute to a varied grassland habitat, while retaining the historic pastoral character of the designed landscape. Works will include the replacement of damaged fence sections, posts, strainers, wire and associated fittings as required, with existing serviceable materials retained where appropriate. Lot 2 â Stem Injection Control for Rhododendron Ponticum Rhododendron (R. ponticum) is a highly invasive non-native species which has colonised semi-natural woodland throughout areas of Brodick Country Park. The plant was introduced to Brodick Castle Gardens as an ornamental species during Victorian times, when it was also planted in shelter belts and as game cover on the wider estate. Over time, R. ponticum has spread from these original plantings, infesting semi-natural woodland and threatening these areasâ biodiversity. There is concern that Phytophthora kernoviae (or P. ramorum, currently present on the island) may return to the grounds and threaten the health of native as well as horticultural trees and shrubs, emphasising the high importance of controlling rhododendron, one of its main host species, in the wider estate. This contract forms part of the National Trust for Scotlandâs ongoing programme to control and ultimately eradicate rhododendron (Rhododendron ponticum) from Brodick Country Park.

The Department of National Defence has a requirement for up to three (3) Selective Laser Sintering (SLS) 3D Printers intended for high-performance manufacturing applications, such as prototyping, tooling and production of end-use parts composed of thermoplastic polymer powders. This procurement process is intended to result in the acquisition of up to three (3) SLS 3D Printers. The equipment being bid in this requirement must fully comply with the Technical Specifications within the Request for Proposal solicitation document. The deliverables are required no later than March 31, 2027. The Crown retains the rights to negotiate with suppliers on any procurement. Documents may be submitted in either official language of Canada.

description: Vartiointi- ja turvallisuuspalveluiden hankinta Länsi-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialue (myöhemmin myös Tilaaja) pyytää tarjouksia Vartiointi- ja turvallisuuspalveluiden hankintaan. Hankinnan kohteena on koko Länsi-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialueen Vartiointi- ja turvallisuuspalvelut. Hankittavat palvelut jakaantuvat Vartiointi- ja turvallisuuspalveluiden osalta hallinto- ja tukipalveluihin, raportointiin, hälytyskeskuspalveluihin, vartiointiin ja järjestyksenvalvontaan, etävalvontapalveluihin, turvatarkastukseen sekä muihin tarvittaviin turvallisuuspalveluihin. Hankintaan valitaan yksi (1) Toimittaja ja yksi (1) varatoimittaja. Sopimuskausi on toistaiseksi voimassa oleva. Hankinnan ennakoitu arvo on 12 000 000 euroa. Palvelua tuotetaan pääasiallisesti liitteessä 1.5 Vartiointikohteet -kuvatuissa kohteissa. Liite 1.5 on salassa pidettävä liite ja sitä koskee salassapitosopimus. Mahdollisen tarjoajan tulee toimittaa allekirjoitettu ja pyydetyiltä osin täydennetty sitoumus luottamuksellisena sähköpostina hankinta@luvn.fi osoitteeseen. Salassapitositoumus on tarjouspyynnön liitteenä 1.6. Tarkempi kuvaus hankinnan sisällöstä on tarjouspyynnön liitteellä 2. "Hankinnan kohteen kuvaus".,

title: Varmekartlegging og sårbarhet for hetebølger i Trondheim
description: 1. Generelt om oppdragetTrondheim kommune, heretter kalt oppdragsgiver, innbyr til åpen anbudskonkurranse i forbindelse med inngåelse av avtale på “Varmekartlegging og sårbarhet for hetebølger i Trondheim”. Konkurransen kunngjøres i DOFFIN, se www.doffin.no, gjennom oppdragsgiverens konkurransegjennomføringsverktøy (KGV) Mercell.2. BakgrunnTemperaturen i Norge har økt og vil fortsette å øke som følge av klimaendringene. Som følge av den generelle temperaturøkningen vil vi oftere oppleve perioder med ekstrem varme, såkalte “hetebølger”. En “norsk hetebølge” er definert som fem eller flere sammenhengende dager der maksimumtemperaturen er 27 grader eller høyere.Globalt har antallet hetebølger for perioden 2013-2022 økt med 94% sammenlignet med perioden 1986-2005. Også i Norge er det observert en markant økning i antallet hetebølger, samt en geografisk spredning av fenomenet, hvor hetebølger nå oppstår i områder hvor det tidligere har vært uvanlig.Urbane strøk er særlig utsatt for ekstrem varme på grunn av at bygningsmasse og harde overflater, som asfalt, både lagrer og reflekterer varme i nærområdet, noe som bidrar til å forsterke oppvarmingen. Forbrenning og varmetap fra trafikk og industri bidrar også til å øke temperaturen. Dette kalles “varmeøy-effekten”.Trær og annen vegetasjon spiller en viktig rolle for å regulere temperaturen lokalt. Grønne tak kan gi opp til 25 grader lavere temperatur på taket sammenlignet med konvensjonell takpapp. Tilsvarende kan gaterom og parker med vegetasjon gi en lokal temperatursenkning på inntil 10 grader. Med økende varmeproblematikk i urbane miljøer, blir grønnstruktur et viktig verktøy i arealplanlegginga for å redusere de negative effektene. Ekstrem varme bidrar til økt dødelighet og flere negative helsekonsekvenser. I perioden 2000-2019 ble det registrert 20 000 ekstra dødsfall per år, som følge av ekstrem varme i Europa. Hetebølger sammenfaller ofte med økt luftforurensing, noe som øker dødeligheten som følge av kardiovaskulære og respiratoriske sykdommer. I tillegg kan varmen gi dehydrering, heteslag, hodepine, dårlig søvn og redusert allmennstilstand. I Norge ble det påvist økt dødelighet under hetebølgen i 2025 , mens både Sverige og Finland registrerte økt dødelighet i forbindelse med hetebølgen i 2018.Noen befolkningsgrupper er særlig sårbare for ekstrem varme, f.eks. eldre, små barn og personer med underliggende sykdommer. I tillegg har lavinntektsgrupper, minoriteter, og leietakere som bor i gamle bygg lavere tilpasningsevne ved en hetebølge.Mange land og lokale myndigheter i Europa har utarbeidet rutiner og tiltaksplaner for å redusere de negative effektene av hetebølger. Forskning på tidligere hetebølger tyder på at byer, som har innført tilpasningstiltak og handlingsplaner for ekstrem varme, reduserer sammenhengen mellom hetebølger og negative helseeffekter. Det kan derfor antas at tilpasningstiltak er en effektiv måte for å redusere de negative konsekvensene. I Danmark oppgir en tredjedel av alle kommunene at de jobber med tilpasning til hetebølger, og i Sverige har over 80% av kommunene utarbeidet beredskapsplaner for høye temperaturer for sårbare grupper. I Norge har konsekvenser av hetebølger i liten grad blitt inkludert og håndtert i planverk og handlingsplaner, verken på nasjonalt, regionalt eller kommunalt nivå.

Tämä kilpailutettava hankintapaketti on Kantametron kuilut Paketti 4, kilpailutustunnus 49H25. Paketti 4 sisältää seuraavat kuilut: - Antinkadun kuilu (KP2) - Kaisaniemen eteläinen kuilu (HY1) - Laiturin varauloskäyntiportaikko (HY2) - Kaisaniemen pohjoinen kuilu (HY3) Kohde sisältää Kantametron huoltokuilujen (4 kpl) kattavan teknisen peruskorjauksen, jossa keskitytään sekä rakenteellisiin että teknisiin parannuksiin. Tarkoituksena on ratkaista erilaisia ongelmia, kuten huonontuneen betonin korjaaminen, ilmanvaihto-, valaistus- ja paloturvallisuusjärjestelmien parantaminen sekä vesiongelmien, kuten vuotojen ja jään muodostumisen, ratkaiseminen. Peruskorjaukseen sisältyy myös teknisten järjestelmien, kuten lämmitys-, ilmanvaihtojärjestelmien, sähköjärjestelmän ja paloteknisten laitteiden kunnostus ja modernisointi. Hankkeessa käytetään kestäviä rakennusmateriaaleja, vähähiilisiä rakennuskäytäntöjä ja energiatehokkaita tekniikoita yhtiön ympäristötavoitteiden mukaisesti. Peruskorjauksen tarkoituksena on varmistaa, että kuilut pysyvät turvallisina, toimivina ja tehokkaina vähintään seuraavat 25 vuotta. Kaikkien urakkaan sisältyvien rakennus- ja teknisten ratkaisujen, rakenteiden, materiaalien, laitteiden ja muiden toteutettavien kokonaisuuksien tulee olla käyttötarkoitukseensa soveltuvia, kestäviä ja tarkoituksenmukaisesti mitoitettuja siten, että niiden suunniteltu käyttöikä ja tekninen kestävyys vastaavat vähintään 25 vuoden tavoitekäyttöikää, ottaen huomioon kohteen käyttöolosuhteet, ympäristöolosuhteet ja huolto- sekä kunnossapitotarpeet. Kohteet on yksilöity tarkemmin työselostuksissa sekä suunnitelma-asiakirjoissa. Työt suoritetaan tarjouspyyntöasiakirjojen esittämässä laajuudessa. Kaikkien asennettavien materiaalien, käytettävien aineiden ja laitteiden tulee olla uusia ja virheettömiä alkuperäiseen pakkaukseen pakattuja. Kilpailutuksen tekniset liiteasiakirjat luokitellaan luottamukselliseksi, koska aineisto sisältää tilaajan infrastruktuuriin liittyviä kriittisiä tietoja. Liiteasiakirjat on luovutettavissa tarjouksen laatimista harkitsevalle yritykselle allekirjoitetun salassapitositoumuslomakkeen toimittamisen jälkeen. Salassapitositoumus (Liite 16) toimitetaan sähköpostilla alla oleviin osoitteisiin: - pekka.alanne@castek.fi - rebeca.romero@kaupunkiliikenne.fi - kilpailutus@kaupunkiliikenne.fi Allekirjoitetun salassapitositoumuksen jälkeen yritykselle toimitetaan sähköpostitse linkki NiiniPlus-projektipankkiin. Hankintayksikkö varaa oikeuden arvioida pyyntöön liittyvät perustelut ja tarvittaessa pyytää lisätietoja. Rakennuttaja edellyttää, että tarjouksenantaja on käynyt tutustumassa urakkakohteeseen tarjouspyynnön saatuaan ja ennen tarjouksen jättämistä sekä on tutustunut kaikkiin tarjouspyynnön mukana oleviin asiakirjoihin ennen tarjouksen antamista. Tutustuminen urakkakohteeseen järjestetään 28.10.2026 klo 23.00. Ilmoittautuminen tutustumiskäynnille tulee tehdä etukäteen alla oleviin sähköpostiosoitteisiin: - pekka.alanne@castek.fi - rebeca.romero@kaupunkiliikenne.fi Tutustumiseen pääsyn ehtona on yllä mainitun, asianmukaisesti täytetyn salassapitositoumuksen palauttaminen siinä mainittuihin sähköpostiosoitteisiin. Ilmoittautuminen tulee tehdä 26.10.2026 klo 12.00 mennessä. Ilmoittautumisen yhteydessä annetaan tarkempaa tietoa tutustumiskohteesta. title: Access Control and Intrusion Detection Services
description: The Canada Revenue Agency (CRA) requires the provision of parts and labour (technical support, programming, installation, service, and maintenance) on an “as and when requested” basis for its Integrated Security System (ISS) at CRA locations across Canada. The CRA is considering the conversion of up to 51 sites currently using a combination of Digital Security Controls (DSC) Intrusion Detection Systems and Kantech Access Control systems to a unified Kantech Intrusion/Access Control platform. The site counts identified below represent the CRA’s current intended conversion plans for planning and estimation purposes only and do not constitute a commitment to convert any specific number of sites. The CRA requires the goods and services referenced above in the following regions: 1. National Capital Region (NCR) – up to 11 sites identified for potential conversion; 2. Ontario – up to 13 sites identified for potential conversion; 3. Quebec – up to 1 site identified for potential conversion; 4. Atlantic – up to 4 sites identified for potential conversion; and 5. Western – up to 22 sites identified for potential conversion. Bidders may submit a bid for one (1) or more Regions identified in this RFP. Only one (1) bid submission is required, regardless of the number of Regions for which the Bidder is submitting a bid. The Bidder's submission must clearly identify each Region for which it is proposing to provide the required goods and services. For each Region bid, the Bidder must provide all information required by this RFP, including any Region-specific technical information, resource information, and pricing, in the format prescribed in the bid solicitation documents. Requirement, project experience, certification, corporate qualification, or other bid components that are not Region-specific need only be submitted once and will be evaluated for all Regions included in the Bidder's submission. Bids for Multiple Regions: Requirements identified as Region-specific will be evaluated only for the applicable Region. Requirements that are not Region-specific will be evaluated once and will apply to all Regions included in the Bidder's submission. The CRA will evaluate each Region independently. Where a Bidder fails to meet a Region-specific requirement, the CRA may declare the bid non-responsive for that Region only. For greater certainty, a determination that a bid is non-responsive for one (1) Region will not, in itself, render the Bidder's submission non-responsive for any other Region for which a bid as been submitted, provided all applicable requirements for those Regions are met. The CRA intends to award up to five (5) contracts to fulfill this requirement. A Bidder may be awarded a contract for one (1) Region, multiple Regions, or all five (5) Regions. The period of the resulting contract(s) will be for three (3) firm years. The contract(s) will include four (4) irrevocable one-year options to extend the period of the contract(s). The contract(s) will also include provisions allowing the CRA to add, remove or modify products and sites. A bid must comply with the requirements of the bid solicitation and meet all mandatory evaluation criteria to be declared responsive. For each Region, the responsive bid with the highest combined rating of technical merit and price will be recommended for award of a contract. Each Region will be evaluated separately. Where the same Bidder is ranked first for multiple Regions, the CRA will award a single contract covering the Regions for which that Bidder is the highest-ranked responsive bidder. The Bid Compliance and Remedy Process (BCRP) defined in Part 4.2 will apply. Proposal documents and supporting information must be submitted in either English or French. Questions must be directed in writing to the contracting authority via email: Timothy.Berg@cra-arc.gc.ca Bids must be submitted by using the Connect service provided by the Canada Post Corporation. When responding, the proposal MUST be delivered to: Canada Revenue Agency Bid Receiving Unit BRUg@cra-arc.gc.ca Bids will not be accepted if emailed directly to this email address. This email address must be used to request that CRA open a Connect conversation, as detailed in Standard Instructions 2003. Bidders must not use their own licensing agreement for Connect to initiate a Connect conversation with CRA. The CRA reserves the right to negotiate with suppliers on any procurement. There are security requirements associated with this requirement. For additional information, consult the bid solicitation document. The Federal Contractors Program (FCP) for employment equity applies to this procurement. This bid solicitation 1000536720/B cancels and supersedes previous bid solicitation number 1000536720/A dated 2026-03-27 with a closing of 2026-05-19 02:00 PM EDT. This solicitation is open only to Canadian suppliers and to Suppliers of an applicable trading partner. For additional information, consult the bid solicitation document. The CRA will include the following minimum work guarantees (all applicable taxes included) over the entire period of the resulting contract(s), which includes any exercised option periods, including any extension period thereof: 1. National Capital Region (NCR) – $100,000 CAD; 2. Ontario – $100,000 CAD; 3. Quebec – $50,000 CAD; 4. Atlantic – $50,000 CAD; and 5. Western – $100,000 CAD.

title: Steveston (Paramount) Utility Dike Crossings, Richmond, BC
description: Small Craft Harbours (SCH) requires the installation of underground High Density Polyethylene (HDPE) casings through an existing dike, at four (4) locations (Crossing A, B, C and D) in Steveston Paramount in preparation for future electrical and water underground installations. Summary of crossings are as follows: • Crossing A – 2 HDPE DR 17 450mm diameter for electrical and communication. • Crossing B – 1 HDPE DR 11 300mm diameter for waterline plus multiple tie ins to existing water pipe. • Crossing C – 2 HDPE DR 17 450mm diameter and 1 HDPE DR 11 300mm diameter for electrical, communication and waterline • Crossing D – 1 HDPE DR 11 300mm diameter for waterline. Crossing A and C require installation of electrical and communication pull box on both sides of the dike. Crossing B require re-routing water supply from the existing asbestos cement pipe to new HDPE DR 11 300mm watermain along Trites Road with multiple tie-ins to existing underground water line and into existing backflow preventor. Contractor shall provide all supervision, labour, materials, supplies, tools, equipment, transportation, quality control, health and safety practices, environmental protection, and all other necessary services for the proper and complete execution of the work. Work of this Contract is located at 12740 Trites Road, Richmond, BC, Canada Familiarization with site: Before submitting a bid, bidders can visit the site and its surroundings, at their own expense, to review and verify the form, nature, and extent of the work, materials needed for the completion of the work, the means of access to the site, severity, exposure, and uncertainty of weather, soil conditions, any accommodations they may require, and in general shall obtain all necessary information as to risks, contingencies, and other circumstances which may influence or affect their bid. No allowance shall be made subsequently in this connection on account or error or negligence to properly observe and determine the conditions that will apply. Timeline: All work including clean-up and demobilization must be completed by March 31, 2027.

title: Lightspeed satellite services
description: This ACAN is being issued by Shared Services Canada (SSC) to satisfy the requirement for the provision and operation of Lightspeed Low Earth Orbiting satellite services (called Lightspeed Services) on an ‘’as and when’’ required basis.What is an ACAN: An ACAN is a public notice indicating to the supplier community that a department or agency intends to award a contract for goods, services or construction to a pre-identified supplier, thereby allowing other suppliers to signal their interest in bidding, by submitting a Statement of capabilities. If no supplier submits a Statement of capabilities that meets the requirements set out in the ACAN, on or before the closing date stated in the ACAN, the Contracting Officer may then proceed with the award to the pre-identified supplier.This ACAN relates to 1 contract proposed to be awarded to 1 contractor and will be used by Shared Services Canada.Definition of the Requirement: Shared Services Canada (SSC) has a requirement for the provision and operation of Lightspeed Low Earth Orbiting satellite services (called Lightspeed Services) as provided by Telesat LEO ULC on an as-and-when required basis for use by SSC and its partner organizations/clients. Lightspeed provides Canada’s only sovereign enterprise-grade low earth orbit satellite constellation. Lightspeed has inter-satellite link capabilities, enabling any traffic originating outside of Canada to land in Canada (within applicable regulatory policies) directly through Canadian gateways.  Lightspeed Services are categorized by its low latency, high throughput, dedicated bandwidth capacity (committed information rate), public networking along with terrestrial landing station infrastructure and Points of Presence (PoP) globally, private networking with Private Access Stations (PAS) at their facilities, dedicated backhaul capability, enterprise level and fully managed services capability and coverage of Canada; and  globally.  Enterprise level and fully managed services include, but are not limited to: site survey, installation, commissioning, helpdesk, billing, ongoing maintenance, engineering and customer support. SSC Lightspeed satellite services - Amendment 000

title: Cascade de Barberine, Rénovation majeure– Appel d’offres Lot 401 Génératrice G3 et Lot 402 Turbine Pelton avec vanne sphérique et conduite de distribution
description:
Dans le cadre du projet «Cascade de Barberine, Rénovation majeure», CFF SA prévoit la rénovation de plusieurs installations de l’usine. L’usine de Châtelard I est située dans le Châtelard, sur la commune de Finhaut en Valais. Elle a été construite entre 1919 et 1923. En 1972, l’usine a été agrandie par l’installation de Châtelard II. L’usine sert principalement à l’alimentation en courant de traction (16,7 Hz) de la Suisse romande et de la ligne du Simplon.


L’objet de l’appel d’offres porte sur le remplacement de l’ensemble des unités de production existantes de l’usine de Châtelard-Barberine I par un seul groupe de 40 MVA composé d’une turbine Jumelle Pelton (2+2) à axe horizontal et d’un générateur synchrone 16,7 Hz monophasé, réparti en 2 lots:


-    Lot 1: Lot 401 Générateur G3

-    Lot 2: Lot 402 Turbine Pelton T3 avec turbine Pelton, vannes sphériques et conduite de distribution


Le soumissionnaire peut présenter une offre portant sur un seul lot ou une offre globale (pour connaître les lots, voir la liste de prix au format Excel). Si un soumissionnaire remporte les deux lots, un seul contrat sera conclu.


L’étendue de la livraison du lot 401 Générateur G3 porte sur le remplacement complet de tous les générateurs synchrones actuellement installés à l’usine de Châtelard-Barberine I par un nouveau générateur synchrone 16,7 Hz monophasé de 40 MVA comprenant l’arbre, les paliers, les systèmes d’excitation et les systèmes auxiliaires. Les prestations du lot portent essentiellement sur les calculs, les dessins techniques, la fabrication, le montage en atelier, l’emballage, le transport, l’entreposage sur le chantier, le démontage, le montage, la mise en service, la formation du personnel, les tests en atelier et sur le chantier par l’entreprise dans le cadre des interfaces définies.


Le lot 402 Turbine Pelton T3 avec turbine Pelton, vanne sphérique et conduite de distribution comprend trois systèmes: La turbine Pelton T3 avec régulateur, la vanne sphérique de la turbine Pelton T3 et la conduite de distribution T3.


Le système «Turbine Pelton T3» est une turbine Pelton horizontale jumelle (2+2) avec des roues montées dans l’appareil et une vitesse de rotation de 501 tr/min pour l’entraînement direct d’un générateur synchrone 16,7 Hz. La livraison comprend également le régulateur de la turbine et les systèmes auxiliaires nécessaires.


Le système «conduite de distribution» comprend la livraison d’un nouveau système de distribution pour le nouveau groupe MG3 pour une plage de débit d’environ 6 m3/s. La nouvelle conduite de distribution doit être raccordée à la conduite forcée existante et l’eau motrice doit être amenée aux deux roues Pelton par deux conduites de dérivation.


Le système «vanne sphérique» comprend deux vannes sphériques d’une pression nominale de 9,4 MPa chacune. Celles-ci servent d’organes de fermeture et sont chacune disposées dans une conduite de dérivation vers les deux roues Pelton. Les systèmes auxiliaires nécessaires sont également inclus dans la livraison.

title: Zambia – Water pumps – Bau von Solar-PV-Stromerzeugungssystemen und Austausch und Sanierung von Pumpensystemen
description: Das Projekt „Nexus Energy Water Programme for Zambia“ (NEWZA) zielt darauf ab, die Verflechtung zwischen dem Energie- und dem Wassersektor zu stärken. Das Projekt wird von der Europäischen Union (EU) und dem Bundesministerium für wirtschaftliche Zusammenarbeit und Entwicklung (BMZ) der Bundesrepublik Deutschland über die KfW kofinanziert. Das NEWZA-Programm umfasst auch laufende Projekte, die von der deutschen Bundesregierung kofinanziert werden, nämlich: • Programm „Städtische Wasserversorgung und Abwasserentsorgung in der Ostprovinz, Phase IV“ (BMZ-Nr.: 2016 67 328/2018 67 514/2018 70 104) und • Management von Wasserressourcen und Abwasserentsorgung für mittelgroße Städte (BMZ-Nr.: 2020 67 494, 2022 70 023). Das Ziel von NEWZA ist es, den Zugang zu grüner Energie und Wasserversorgung für alle zu verbessern, indem die Leistungsfähigkeit von fünf sambischen Wasserversorgungsunternehmen gesteigert wird: Southern (Los 1), Chambeshi (Los 2), Lukanga (Los 3), Nkana (Los 4) und Eastern (Los 5). Die Arbeiten werden auf der Grundlage des FIDIC-Vertrags für Anlagen und Design-Build-Verträge, 1. Auflage 1999 (Yellow Book), vergeben. Der Arbeitsumfang für alle kommerziellen Versorgungsunternehmen ist nachstehend aufgeführt. Diese Liste dient lediglich der Veranschaulichung des Umfangs und ist nicht als vollständige Auflistung zu verstehen. Der Arbeitsumfang umfasst: ► Komponente 1 Solar-PV • Projektmanagement, Planung, Installation und Inbetriebnahme der Solaranlagen liegen in der Verantwortung des Auftragnehmers • Das Grundstück für die PV-Anlagen wird entweder innerhalb der Produktions-/Entnahme-/Aufbereitungsanlagen und/oder anderen Standorten der CU bereitgestellt. Reicht die Fläche nicht aus, wird das Grundstück von der CU durch Kauf oder Pacht gesichert • Installation von Online-Überwachungsplattformen für PV-Anlagen, einschließlich Echtzeit-Datenerfassung, -übertragung (GPRS/GSM oder andere), sicherer Cloud-Datenspeicherung und Online-Portalschnittstelle (sicherheitsgeschützt) mit Anzeige der Infrastrukturzustands-/Leistungsdaten auf Standortebene • Betrieb und Wartung für bis zu 2 Jahre nach der Planungs- und Bauphase Teilkomponente 1a – Netzgekoppelte Solar-PV-Anlagen • Entwurf und Lieferung von netzgekoppelten Solarstromanlagen für die bestehenden Wassergewinnungs-/Wasserentnahme-/Wasseraufbereitungsanlagen und/oder andere Standorte der CU. Die Größe der PV-Anlagen ist durch die Kapazität der vorhandenen Nieder-/Mittelspannungs- und Transformatoranlagen begrenzt. • Dies umfasst die Installation von Solar-PV-Modulen, Anschlusskästen, Verkabelung, Filtern (falls erforderlich), Wechselrichtern, Sammelschienenverlängerungen und Niederspannungsfächern (falls erforderlich). • Durchführung von Standortmessungen der Stromdaten zum Vergleich des Stromverbrauchs vor und nach den Arbeiten. Bei Standorten, an denen Pumpen saniert werden, Bewertung des Anteils des Jahresverbrauchs nach der Pumpensanierung. Teilkomponente 1b – Hybride Solar-PV-Anlagen • Entwurf und Lieferung von hybriden Solar-PV-Anlagen für die bestehenden Wassergewinnungs-/Wasserentnahme-/Wasseraufbereitungsanlagen und/oder andere Standorte der CU. Die Größe der Anlage richtet sich nach der Pumpeneingangsleistung (P1) und der Anzahl der Arbeitspumpen. • An Standorten, an denen Hybridtechnologie zum Einsatz kommt, werden auch die Pumpen und die zugehörigen Stromversorgungsanlagen ausgetauscht. • Dies umfasst die Installation von Solar-PV-Modulen, Anschlusskästen, Filtern (nach Bedarf), Hybrid-Wechselrichtern, Niederspannungsausrüstung für Solar-PV und Pumpen sowie Frequenzumrichtern für Pumpen. Der Umfang der Komponente umfasst die Schnittstelle oder Grenze am Anschlusspunkt für die Kabel von der Niederspannungsausrüstung zu den Pumpen. • Online-Überwachungsplattformen für Standorte, an denen das Hybridsystem in ein einziges System für Pumpen und Solar-PV integriert ist. ► Komponente 2 – Pumpensysteme • Sanierung der bestehenden Pumpensystembeklebung, im Wesentlichen: Pumpen, Kabel, Niederspannungs- und Mittelspannungsschalttafeln, Ventile/Armaturen, Rohrleitungen der Pumpstation, Mess- und Regelgeräte • Projektmanagement, Planung, Installation und Inbetriebnahme der Pumpensysteme in Verantwortung des Auftragnehmers • Das System ist auf gleichbleibende oder erhöhte zukünftige Tagesdurchflussmengen gemäß den Anforderungen der CU ausgelegt. Die täglichen Durchflussmengen und die vorgesehenen Betriebsstunden werden in der Ausschreibung angegeben. • Überprüfung des Betriebsdrucks der Steigleitung durch Tests vor Ort, Ermittlung hydraulischer Probleme (nicht funktionierende Luftventile) und Messung der tatsächlichen Durchflussmengen vor Ort und des Energieverbrauchs der Pumpen (alle Betriebsmodi). Die geschätzten Nennleistungen der Pumpen (Durchfluss, Druck, Nennmotorleistung) werden in der Ausschreibung nur zu Informationszwecken angegeben. Die endgültige Dimensionierung der Pumpen zur Erfüllung der Durchflussanforderungen liegt in der Verantwortung des Auftragnehmers. • Installation eines digitalen Online-Fernüberwachungssystems, das an wichtige Messgeräte (Durchfluss, Druck und Leistung) angeschlossen ist, mit einem 3-Jahres-Abonnement (falls zutreffend) für den Zugang. Keine Fernsteuerung der Systeme. • Technischer Support, Betrieb und Wartung für bis zu 2 Jahre Das Projekt muss in Übereinstimmung mit den KfW-Nachhaltigkeitsrichtlinien vorbereitet und durchgeführt werden: https://www.kfw-entwicklungsbank.de/PDF/Download-Center/PDF-Dokumente-Richtlinien/Nachhaltigkeitsrichtlinie_EN.pdf

title: Finland – Cleaning and sanitation services – Aviapoliksen lukion ateria- ja puhtauspalveluiden hankinta
description: Hankinnan kohteena on ateria- ja puhtauspalveluiden hankinta Vantaan kaupungin Aviapoliksen lukiolle tämän tarjouspyynnön ja sen liitteiden mukaisesti. Aviapoliksen lukio otetaan käyttöön asteittain. Alkuvaiheessa vuonna 2027 opiskelijoita arvioidaan olevan 90 opiskelijaa. Henkilökuntaa arvioidaan olevan alkuvaiheessa noin 2-15 henkilöä. Vuonna 2028 oppilasmäärän arvioidaan olevan noin 530 ja henkilökuntaa noin 15-20 henkilöä ja vuonna 2029 oppilasmäärä on arviolta 700 oppilasta. Vuoden 2029 tarkkaa henkilökuntamäärää ei vielä ole tiedossa. Tilaaja valitsee enintään yhden (1) sopimustoimittajan. Sopimus tehdään toistaiseksi voimassa olevaksi. Sopimuksen ehdot on kuvattu tarkemmin tarjouspyynnön liitteenä olevissa sopimusluonnoksissa (liite 1 ja 2). Sopimuskauden arvioitu alkamisajankohta on 1.1.2027. Tilaaja ei sitoudu tarjouspyyntöasiakirjoissa arvioituihin hankintamääriin tai euromääräisiin arvoihin sopimuskaudella. Tarjoajien tarjouksien määrittelemisen helpottamiseksi, Tilaaja järjestää kohteeseen yhteisnäyttöpäivän. Tarjoajien on osallistuttava yhteisnäyttöpäivään, ennen tarjouksen jättämistä. Tarjouspyynnön kohteena olevat tilat ateria- ja puhtauspalveluiden osalta esitellään seuraavasti: Aviapoliksen lukio, 26.10.2026 klo 9.00 Kohteen tilojen esittelytilaisuuksiin tulee ilmoittautua viimeistään 23.10.2026 klo 16.00 mennessä sähköpostitse osoitteeseen ostoyksikko.puhtauspalvelut@vantaa.fi. Tarjoajien tasapuolisen ja syrjimättömän kohtelun vuoksi tarjoajien kohteissa esittämiin kysymyksiin ei vastata. Kaikki yhteisnäyttökierroksilla esiin tulleet kysymykset tulee esittää tarjouspalvelu.fi:n kautta, jonka kautta annetaan myös vastaukset tulleisiin kysymyksiin. Tarjoajan tulee todistaa henkilöllisyys osallistuessaan yhteisnäyttöön. Lisätietoja yhteisnäyttöpäivästä löytyy kohdasta Hankinnan kohteen kriteerit.

title: Notice of Intent DNA Synthesizer
description: The Defense Health Agency Contracting Activity (DHACA) intends to award a Firm Fixed Price, sole source Contract on behalf of the U.S. Army Medical Research Institute of Infectious Diseases (USAMRIID) to DNA Script Inc, located in Cambridge, MA, under the authority of 41 U.S.C. 1901, as prescribed in RFO FAR 12.102(b) Restricting Competition for acquisitions valued over the SAT. This requirement is for the acquisition of 1 benchtop DNA synthesizer system with a preventative maintenance support contract for an additional 4 years. The benchtop unit shall meet the following minimum essential characteristics: 1. The synthesizer table-top dimensions must not exceed: 48�� x 26�� x 29��. The required vacuum cabinet (freestanding) is 33�� x 26�� x 26�� (inches). 2. The synthesizer shall have same-day throughput e.g. 96 oligos of 20 nucleotides in length in approximately 6 hours and 120 nucleotides in less than 24 hours 3. The synthesizer shall synthesize oligos labeled with fluorophores, quenchers, or biotin with the use of appropriate reagent kits with up to 5 colors in parallel. 4. The synthesizer shall be fully automated: oligos are synthesized, quantified, and normalized in a single synthesis run without user interaction following an approximate range of 15 to 30 minutes of setup. 5. The synthesizer shall have console software that can be installed and hosted on a stand-alone, off-network computer connected to the synthesizer. 6. The synthesizer shall have no harsh organic solvents: the product uses biochemistry, composed of water-based reagents, proprietary enzymes, and proprietary nucleotides that are typically compliant with standard laboratory waste management systems. 7. The synthesizer can perform without any specific environmental control (no need for Argon or any Gas). 8. The synthesizer should have an output power capacity of 1800 W / 2200 VA, 120 VAC input/output voltage and NEMA 5-20P input connection. 9. The synthesizer should produce oligos as they occur in biology, producing oligos that are free of molecular defects or blemishes. 10. The data management software shall provide user authentication features to include: password complexity requirements; automatic logout; limited login attempts; and account inactivity period. 11. The data management software shall have full traceability for synthesis runs, quality control runs, instrument maintenance, reagent usage, user identification, and 5 years of support. 12. The synthesizer shall permit data export to a backup medium. 13. The contractor shall provide method validation services and on-site and off-site operator training, as well as on-site start up support. 14. The contractor shall provide onsite preventative and corrective maintenance for analyzers previously used in biocontainment laboratories (following decontamination). 15. The contractor shall be an Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) authorized dealer, authorized distributor, or authorized reseller for the quoted equipment such that OEM warranty and service are provided and maintained by the OEM. All software licensing, warranty, and services associated with the equipment shall be in accordance with OEM terms and conditions. DNA Script is the only vendor who has a benchtop DNA synthesizer capable of producing 96 oligonucleotides of 20 nucleotides in lengths in 6 hours and 120 nucleotides in length in 24 hours. DNA Script also has the capability of adding biotin, quenchers, and fluorescent molecules to the oligonucleotides for downstream applications, reducing the cost of targeting pathogens. DNA Script�s synthesizer is the only unit capable of meeting all the government�s minimum essential characteristics. The safety features built into the synthesizer protect users by reducing the use of hazardous chemicals, dedicated fume vents, and gas cylinders limiting exposer to stored chemicals. This announcement fulfills the synopsis requirement under RFO FAR 5.101(a). This notice of intent is NOT a request for quotations (RFQ) and no solicitation document exists for the requirement; however, if a vendor challenges the basis for this requirement, please submit a capability statement that includes sufficient detail and with convincing evidence that clearly demonstrates the capability to meet the governments requirement. A request for documentation or additional information or submissions that only ask questions will not be considered as an affirmative response. A determination by the Government not to compete based on responses to this notice is solely within the discretion of the Government. Information received will be considered solely for the purpose of determining whether to conduct a competitive procurement or to proceed with a sole source procurement. Any other firms desiring consideration must submit capability statements and identify their interest and capability in providing these services. Responses to this notice must be received no later than 0900 Eastern Time, 2 November 2026. Capability statements shall be submitted via email ONLY as a Microsoft Word or Adobe PDF attachment to the following email addresses ryan.r.jorgensen.civ@health.mil and jayme.l.fletcher2.civ@health.mil. No phone calls will be accepted.

description: Amendment 1: Questions and Answers document has been attached, along with Kern County Wage Determination A site visit will take place on 28 October 2026 at 10:00am PDT. You must provide notice of intent to alexia.del_real@us.af.mil and richard.godoy@us.af.mil by 7:00am PDT on 26 October 2026 to be eligible to attend. PROCEDURES: This acquisition is conducted under RFO Part 12 (Acquisition of Commercial Products and Services). CONTRACT LINE ITEM NUMBERS (CLINs) Offerors must submit firm-fixed pricing on Attachment 2 � Solicitation FA930127Q0006 for CLINS 0001 and 0002. 4. CYBERSECURITY REQUIREMENTS (CMMC LEVEL 1) In accordance with DoD requirements and R-DFARS 252.204-7021 (Contractor Compliance with the Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification Level Requirements), the contractor must meet the following to be eligible for award: CMMC Level 1 Requirement: Offerors must achieve and maintain at least Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC) Level 1 compliance (demonstrating basic cyber hygiene safeguarding Federal Contract Information [FCI]). Assessment & Verification: Offerors must have a current CMMC Level 1 self-assessment posted in the Supplier Performance Risk System (SPRS) of PIEE prior to award. Failure to have an active, qualifying assessment on file may render the offeror ineligible for contract award. Please see Attachment 3 - CMMC Level 1 Guide for assistance. 5. KEY DATES & SCHEDULE Quote Due Date & Time: Monday, 2 November 2026 at 6:30 AM PST Period of Performance: Date of Contract Award through completion of January 2027 turn-in Installation: Initation of install on 30 November 2026 Ceremony Date: 4 December 2026 Removal & Turn-In Window: 4 January 2027 � 8 January 2027 6. EVALUATION The Government will award a contract resulting from this solicitation to the responsible offeror whose offer conforming to the solicitation will be most advantageous to the Government, price and other factors considered. Any resulting contract of this RFQ will be awarded as Firm Fixed-Price. Quotes will be evaluated to determine best value with consideration of the following: Technical Capability: Confirmation demonstrating understanding and capability to adhere to the mandatory schedule and fulfill all requirements in Attachment 1 (SOW). Contractors are to complete necessary provision and clause fill-in information provided within Attachment 2. Price: The total price will be evalauted for fair and reasonableness. Cybersecurity Verification: Affirmation that the contractor meets CMMC Level 1 requirements with an active self-assessment entered in SPRS. Vendor Administrative Information: Company Name, Physical Address, Point of Contact (Name, Title, Phone, Email), SAM Unique Entity Identifier (UEI), CAGE Code, and Verification of Small Business Status under NAICS 238210. A written notice of award, or acceptance of an offer, mailed or otherwise furnished to the successful offeror within the time for acceptance specified in the offer, shall result in a binding contract without further action by either party. Before the offer�s specified expiration time, the Government may accept an offer, or part of an offer, whether or not there are negotiations after its receipt, unless a written notice of withdrawal is received before award. One award will be made under this solicitation. Awards will be conducted under the provisions of RFO Part 12, Acquisition of Commercial Products and Commercial Services. Submit only written offers via e-mail; oral offers will not be accepted. All offerors must be registered with the System for Award Management (SAM). 7. RESPONSES QUESTIONS REGARDING THIS SOLICITATION ARE DUE BY Wednesday, 21 October 2026 on or before 12:00 PM Pacific Daylight Time (PDT). OFFERS ARE DUE BY Monday, 2 November 2026 at 6:30 AM Pacific Standard Time (PST). All submissions are to be sent via email to Contract Specialist Elsa Ortiz Aguilar at elsa.ortiz_aguilar@us.af.mil and Contracting Officer Suzanna Kussman at suzanna.kussman@us.af.mil, via electronic email. No late submissions will be accepted.

description: Royal Canadian Mounted Police has a requirement for two Compact Tractors. As a requirement of the SA, this notice is published on Canadabuys.canada.ca for a period of fifteen (15) calendar days. The requested delivery date for the above-mentioned goods is 01-03-2027. This bid solicitation process is open only to suppliers holding a Supply Arrangement (SA) under the Request (RFSA) E60HS-18AGTR/A. If you wish to become a pre-qualified supplier under this RFSA, refer to: https://canadabuys.canada.ca/en/tender-opportunities/tender-notice/ws4153305060- doc4153316176. The RCMP has adopted the Ineligibility and Suspension Policy administered by Public Services and Procurement Canada. As a result, the supplier integrity and compliance provisions are being applied in RCMP contracting activities as outlined in this solicitation. Indigenous Procurement: The federal Indigenous Business Directory (IBD) is an online resource for all levels of government and the private sector to identify Indigenous business capacity. Having a business profile in the IBD will increase your company’s visibility and may provide additional business. A profile in the IBD can also allow you to compete for federal government contracts that are set-aside for Indigenous businesses through the Procurement Strategy for Indigenous Businesses. For more information and to review eligibility criteria and register, visit: www.canada.ca/indigenousbusinessdirectory. Green Procurement – Environmentally Preferable Packaging The Royal Canadian Mounted Police (RCMP) is committed to promoting the procurement of environmentally preferable plastic products and the reduction of plastic packaging waste as per the Policy on Green Procurement, the Greening Government Strategy: A Government of Canada Directive, and the Ocean Plastics Charter. Offerors are encouraged to use environmentally preferable packaging for all packaged goods to be delivered to the end user as part of this procurement. E60HS-18AGTR ------------------------------------------------------------ Debriefings Bidders may request a debriefing on the results of the bid solicitation. Bidders should make the request to the Contracting Authority within fifteen (15) working days from receipt of notification that their bid was unsuccessful. The debriefing may be provided in writing, by telephone or in person.

title: Energinet Eltransmission A/S, Insurance Procurement related to CAR including DSU, TPL, EIL, and On- and Offshore Terrorism Insurance for Bornholm Energy Island
description: The procurement is conducted as a negotiated procedure with prior call for competition.The tender process thus consists of two parts/phases, including request for prequalification and submission of tender.The procurement covers the insurance placements described in Lots 1-5 below.Lot 1: CAR, TPL primary and offshore terrorism and sabotage – EUR 450 Million any one occurrence, DSU primary (option) – EUR 50 Million in the aggregateLot 2: DSU excess layer – EUR 295 Million xs EUR 50 Million First loss limit and in the aggregateLot 3: TPL excess layer – EUR 75 Million xs EUR 25 Million any one occurrenceLot 4: Onshore Terrorism and Sabotage – EUR 156 Million any one occurrenceLot 5: Environmental Impairment Liability (EIL) – EUR 25 Million any one occurrenceEnerginet Eltransmission A/S reserves the right to award the contract based on the initial tender.There is no remuneration to participants in the negotiations.Costs incurred by the tenderer in connection with the preparation and submission of a tender for one or more lots are the tenderers to bear and will not be reimbursed.There is anticipated to be one negotiation meeting held via Microsoft Teams.
